title: Go Make Money
summary: Give Claude your real money goal, not a task: it finds and confirms what makes you money, reads your raw Threadify rows, finds the biggest funnel leak with receipts, tests your belief, has a different model judge it, agrees an action plan for your setup with you, writes one post from a proven viral structure with an Auto Plug built from your best CTAs, schedules it after one yes, then celebrates with a reward page and an optional Claude check-in that grades the fix on the same numbers.
triggers: why don't my clicks turn into signups
help me get more paying customers

inputs.name: the owner's goal (N paying customers or members by a date), current baseline or UNKNOWN, the confirmed money activity, connected Threadify account (posts, tracked links, signups, offers, conversion setup, greatest hits, vault), the public landing page, optional data/ files such as YouTube analytics

outputs.name: go-make-money/<date>/ folder with goal.json, money.json, raw/ reads, funnel.json, beliefs.json, judge.json, short-seller.json, decisions.json, library.json, fix.json, report.html, reward.html and an optional checkin.json/checkin.ics, plus the goal ledger at ~/.threadify/go-make-money/ledger.json

free_capabilities: money activity from raw tracked links: where clicks, signups and paid go, matched to saved offers, confirmed with the owner
deterministic goal and pace math: required_net_new_per_week = ceil((goal - current) / weeks_left), unknown baseline labelled needs real baseline
deterministic funnel from raw per-link and per-post rows: views, clicks, signups, paid, per-step rates, the biggest drop and its upside at a rule-of-thumb rate
belief tests: promise vs landing page words, and CTA reach from retention data
outside judge on a different model (codex exec read-only, else a fresh Claude) with a hard time limit
short-seller quote check, action ranking, channel-aware copy guard with a weak social proof warning, and casing guard
template and CTA library from the owner's own click-driving posts and Auto Plugs
goal ledger that grades the last fix on the same numbers
local phone-width report and a Threadify-branded celebration page with confetti, achievements and a GitHub star CTA
Claude check-in through the host's scheduler, or a calendar reminder file
paid_capability_stubs: link attribution and post performance history depend on the plan's analytics window
Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
Auto Plug replies need a plan that includes Auto Plug
connected offer changes, scheduling and readback

must_show: the agreed action plan, in order, with why
the exact change: offer fields before and after, the exact post and Auto Plug in full in chat, the exact page copy, or the exact diff
local date and time for a scheduled post

instructions: Without a Threadify connection, stop after the goal and say what to connect.
When a number is not returned, show it as UNKNOWN, never 0; an unknown baseline is labelled needs real baseline.
When conversion tracking is not measurable, signups and paid are UNKNOWN.
When neither codex nor the claude command line is installed, say the outside judge could not run; never invent a verdict.
Never write posts yourself when Threadify generation is unavailable; report the blocker.
When Auto Plug is not on the plan, state the tier and offer the post without a plug.
Never create, rename or duplicate an offer per run; create_offer only when the account has no offer at all, with its own yes.
When the host holds an approved call (an approval queue, hook or gate), say where to approve it and wait; never route around it.
When no scheduler is available for the check-in, write a calendar reminder file instead.
Never merge a landing-page pull request; open it and print its URL only.

must_prove: raw read windows and destination filter
funnel counts and the leak with receipts
post template source and CTA source
